description: This file defines the interface for a dispatcher component within the WPEFramework plugin host. It declares the IDispatcher interface, its nested ICallback interface, and related methods for event handling, validation, invocation, and callback management.

classes.name: IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for dispatching remote procedure calls and managing callbacks within the plugin host.

classes.name: IDispatcher::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for handling events, errors, and responses related to dispatched calls.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token for a specific method with optional parameters.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method with a callback, channel, and token, returning a response.

methods.name: Local
methods.description: Provides access to a local dispatcher instance if needed.
